title: Warm Gooey Thai Gelatin Noodles
description: A bitter and energizing Thai dish featuring unflavored gelatin, perfect for a unique dessert experience, this sugar-free friendly treat is sure to satisfy any sweet tooth without the guilt
instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the gelatin over 1 cup of cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes to soften
In a medium saucepan, combine the Thai tea mix and 2 cups of water, and bring to a boil over high heat
Reduce the heat to medium and add the softened gelatin, stirring until it is fully dissolved
Add the coconut milk, stevia powder, and salt to the saucepan, and stir until the mixture is smooth and hot
Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions and set aside
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat and add the cooked noodles, stirring to coat
Pour the gelatin mixture over the noodles and stir until they are well coated
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, or until it is hot and gooey
Serve the warm gooey noodles immediately, garnished with sesame seeds or chopped nuts if desired
